description: CLI tool that synchronizes all starred GitHub repositories to the local filesystem, cloning new repos and pulling existing ones.

deployment.notes: Run via `bun src/cli.ts` or compiled binary `dist/starsync`. No server, no container, no CI/CD pipeline.

auth.mechanism: GitHub Personal Access Token (GITHUB_TOKEN) read from .env file via dotenv
auth.notes: Single-user CLI; token is user-provided. No multi-user auth, no sessions, no OAuth flow.

details: Reads user's GitHub starred repositories via authenticated API
Clones/pulls public and potentially private repositories to local filesystem
No database, no persisted user data beyond cloned repos
No PII collected or stored by the tool itself

criticality.justification: Personal developer utility. No production users, no SLAs, no revenue dependency. Failure modes are limited to incomplete syncs.
